mapper.sql: id, subject_type, subject_id, change_type, target_user_id, role_id, permission_id, effect, data_scope_code, effective_from, effective_to, before_value, after_value, reason, operator_id, occurred_time, request_id, affected_user_ids, affected_users_snapshot
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_authorization_history (subject_type, subject_id, change_type, target_user_id, role_id, permission_id, effect, data_scope_code, effective_from, effective_to, before_value, after_value, reason, operator_id, occurred_time, request_id, affected_user_ids, affected_users_snapshot) VALUES (#{subjectType}, #{subjectId}, #{changeType}, #{targetUserId}, #{roleId}, #{permissionId}, #{effect}, #{dataScopeCode}, #{effectiveFrom}, #{effectiveTo}, #{beforeValue}, #{afterValue}, #{reason}, #{operatorId}, #{occurredTime}, #{requestId}, #{affectedUserIds}, #{affectedUsersSnapshot})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_authorization_history WHERE target_user_id = #{targetUserId} ORDER BY occurred_time DESC, id DESC
SELECT FROM t_authorization_history WHERE subject_id = #{employeeId} AND subject_type IN ('ORGANIZATION_ASSIGNMENT', 'REPORTING_RELATION') ORDER BY occurred_time DESC, id DESC

SELECT h.id, h.subject_type, h.subject_id, h.change_type, h.target_user_id, h.role_id, h.permission_id, h.effect, h.data_scope_code, h.effective_from, h.effective_to, h.before_value, h.after_value, h.reason, h.operator_id, h.occurred_time, h.request_id, h.affected_users_snapshot, COALESCE(NULLIF((SELECT MAX(l.user_name) FROM t_operation_log l WHERE l.request_id = h.request_id), ''), '系统') AS operator_name, NULL AS operator_employee_no FROM t_authorization_history h WHERE (h.target_user_id = #{userId} OR h.affected_user_ids LIKE CONCAT('%,', #{userId}, ',%')) AND h.occurred_time >= #{startTime} AND h.occurred_time <= #{endTime} ORDER BY h.occurred_time DESC, h.id DESC
